_help: The featured-partner banners right under the home-page hero: a slot you can sell. 'partners' lists one or more restaurant keys (restaurant-offers.json) or brand keys (brands.json); each gets its own banner, side by side, with wording, logo and link from that partner. With a single partner you can write your own wording: "title", "text" and/or "cta" as { "en": "...", "ar": "..." }, and "url" to link somewhere else. Set "sponsored" to true when the partners pay for the slot: it is then labelled Sponsored / إعلان (required for paid placements) and outside links get rel="sponsored". The banners hide themselves after "until" (YYYY-MM-DD, Cairo time), even without a rebuild. Set "active" to false to remove them. Edit in foodidu.com/dashboard/ (إدارة المحتوى) or here, then run: perl tools/build.pl
